 FSU releases updated depth chart ahead of Pitt game: The injury shuffle continues
 Here's a position-by-position breakdown of the Seminoles' depth chart with Pitt on-deck for them.
 Chris Nee 2 Florida State Seminoles football faces Pitt at Acrisure Stadium on Friday evening at 7 p.m.
 Below is an updated depth chart for FSU prior to the game via the flipcard:
 Quarterback
 1. Ashton Daniels (5th)
 2. Kevin Sperry (SO)
 Running Back
 1. Quintrevion Wisner  (SR) 
 2. Amari Thomas (FR)
 3. Zay Parks (JR)
 Wisner is listed as the starter on the flip card, but due to injury he is expected to be out against Pitt. Thomas should get the start at running back. 
 Wide Receiver
 1.  Jasen Lopez  (FR)
 2. Teriq Mallory (SO)
 1. Micahi Danzy (JR)
 2. Devin Carter  (FR)
 1. Jayvan Boggs (SO)
 2. Tae'Shaun Gelsey   (SO)
 Tight End
 1. Desirrio Riles (SR) OR Landen Thomas (JR)
 Left Tackle
 1. Xavier Chaplin (5th)
 2.  Jonathan Daniels (JR)
 Daniels, not  Chastan Brown , is now listed as the reserve behind Chaplin. 
 Left Guard
 1. André Otto (SR)
 2. Paul Bowling (SO)
 Center
 1.  Chavez Thompson (SO)
 2. Jayden Todd (JR)
 Bradyn Welch-Joiner   was lost for the season due to an injury suffered at Boston College, moving Thompson into the starting role. Todd slides in as the new reserve. 
 Right Guard
 1.  Paul Bowling   (SO)
 2.  Nate Pabst (5th)
 Right Tackle
 1.  Nate Pabst   (5th)
 2.  Chimdia Nwaiwu (SR)
 Daniels is no longer listed as the third option at right tackle. 
 Defensive End
 1. Darryll Desir (SO)
 2.  Cam Brooks (FR)
 Defensive Tackle
 1. Daniel Lyons (5th)
 2. Jordan Sanders (5th)
 FSU remains without Kevin Wynn once again due to injury. 
 Defensive Tackle
 1.  Mandrell Desir  (SO)
 2.  Deamontae Diggs   (5th)
 FSU is without defensive tackle Deante McCray for the second consecutive game due to an injury. 
 Jack
 1. Rylan Kennedy (SR)
 2. Jalen Anderson (JR)
 Linebacker
 1. Chris Jones  (JR)
 2.  Caleb LaVallee   (SR)
 1.  Omar Graham Jr.  (5th)
 2.  Mikai Gbayor (5th)
 Cornerback
 1. Ja'Bril Rawls   (SR)
 2. Charles Lester III (JR)
 1.  Nehemiah Chandler (JR)
 2.  Ricky Knight III (JR)
 Quindarrius Jones   is out for the third consecutive game. 
 Rover
 1. Ashlynd Barker (5th)
 2. Max Redmon (SO)
 Safety
 1. CJ Richard Jr. (JR) 
 2.  K.J. Kirkland  (SR) OR Antonio Cromartie Jr. (SO)
 Nickel
 1.  Ma'Khi Jones  (SO)
 2. Ricky Knight III (JR) OR Jordan Crutchfield (FR)
 Kicker
 1. Gabe Panikowski (5th)
 2. Conor McAneney (SO)
 Kickoff
 1. McAneney (SO) OR Panikowski (5th)
 Punter
 1. Daniel Hughes (SR) OR  Ethan Post (SO)
 Post, who started last week, moves up from the second line to an -or- situation this week. 
 Long Snapper
 1. Caleb Bowers (5th)
 2. Alex Nocco (SO)
 Holder
 1. Carter Jula (JR)
 2. Hughes (SR)
 Kick Returner
 1. Carter (FR)
 2. Danzy (JR)
 Devin Carter, who returned kicks last week, moves into the starter role. Danzy slides down a spot. Amari Thomas no longer listed, after previously being the reserve behind Danzy.
 Punt Returner
 1. Lopez (FR)
 2. Boggs (SO)
